rationale: Builds directly on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a small structural change: the decoder-output anchor is no longer frozen across both recurrent tail replays. Instead it is refreshed toward each replayed state by a fixed scalar, which should reduce stale-anchor overconstraint in the 2-block tail while keeping shapes, compile behavior, parameter count, and export path unchanged. This targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor neighborhood without repeating learned/gated anchor variants or broad hyperparameter sweeps.
title: Deterministic Tail Anchor Refresh
